Test Steps: Start server from clean restart; watch console from exec local.cfg through misc.cfg; run status after resources load.
Expected Result: No dependency errors; ox_lib and qbx_core start before dependent resources; custom bcrp/srp resources start after framework.
Notes: Check duplicate ensure [shell] and local-resources overrides.

Test Steps: Confirm local-resources.cfg loads after main ensures; verify [npwd-apps], [npwd], [vehicles], [test] are not double-starting problem resources.
Expected Result: No duplicate-start warnings or unexpected resource restarts.
Notes: ox_target debug is set to 1 here; disable before production if not wanted.

Test Steps: Restart server; watch oxmysql connection; create/load a character; buy an item; relog.
Expected Result: No SQL connection errors; character, inventory, money, vehicles, MDT/phone data persist.
Notes: DB-dependent: qbox schema plus resource SQL/import files.

Test Steps: Join with a fresh license or test slot; create character; complete appearance; continue to spawn.
Expected Result: Character saves; appearance applies; no soft lock or black screen.

Test Steps: Create or select character with property/apartment; choose available spawn; enter world; relog and select again.
Expected Result: Player appears at chosen spawn/interior; bucket resets correctly after exit/relog.
Notes: Live DB and routing bucket sensitive.

Test Steps: As a newly spawned player, find welcome/help target zones; use Converse/travel help; request taxi/destination.
Expected Result: Menu opens; news/help item works; taxi/destination flow starts without errors.
Notes: Custom srp; test after framework updates.

Test Steps: Open inventory with TAB/K/F1; move items; drop an item; relog; pick item back up if appropriate.
Expected Result: Inventory UI opens; item state persists; drops display correctly; no stuck controls.

Test Steps: Use burger/water/coffee/soda/alcohol items; observe animation, progress, metadata, hunger/thirst/stress changes.
Expected Result: Item consumes once; correct status changes; no duplicate use or missing animation.
Notes: Includes shop metadata variants like srp-eating.

Test Steps: Use lockpick and advancedlockpick against a supported locked vehicle/robbery interaction.
Expected Result: Skill/check flow starts; success/fail removes or damages item as configured; no free unlock exploit.
Notes: Also impacts robberies and vehicle theft.

Test Steps: Enter vehicle; use harness; drive/crash lightly in controlled test; remove/consume harness if applicable.
Expected Result: Harness applies; UI/state reflects harness; crash behavior matches config.

Test Steps: Use id_card and driver_license near another player; have second player confirm display/data.
Expected Result: Card animation plays; nearby player sees correct character info; metadata is accurate.

Test Steps: Use binoculars item; zoom/look around; cancel; use again after relog.
Expected Result: Overlay and controls work; player exits cleanly; item not consumed unless intended.

Test Steps: Use tent, scenelight, campfire, chairs, beach items, police/fire props; move away and return; pick up/delete.
Expected Result: Prop appears, targets attach, item returns/removes correctly, cleanup commands work.
Notes: Custom srp; high multiplayer sync risk.

Test Steps: As EMS/fire, use fire vest item; verify UI/equipment state; remove/relog.
Expected Result: Vest applies and persists/clears as intended; no permanent armor/clothing bug.

Test Steps: Admin set each configured job; toggle duty where available; verify pay and job label in UI.
Expected Result: All 18 jobs assign correctly; grades and boss flags match config; off-duty restrictions work.
Notes: Jobs: unemployed, police, bcso, sasp, ambulance, realestate, taxi, bus, cardealer, mechanic, judge, lawyer, reporter, trucker, tow, garbage, vineyard, hotdog.

Test Steps: Set boss grade for police, ambulance, mechanic, realestate, cardealer; open boss/society menu and banking.
Expected Result: Only boss/bankAuth grades can manage society funds/employees.

Test Steps: Set taxi job; go on duty; start NPC fare; pick up/drop off; receive payment; cancel route.
Expected Result: Route, NPC, fare, payment, and cleanup work.
Notes: Also compare with citra-taxi AI taxi.

Test Steps: Call taxi from radial/welcome flow; enter taxi; change speed; cancel ride.
Expected Result: Taxi arrives, drives to destination, controls work, fare/cancel has no errors.
Notes: Live pathing can fail in dense map areas.

Test Steps: Set bus job; start route; stop at multiple stops; finish/cancel route.
Expected Result: Markers and payments work; vehicle cleanup succeeds.
Notes: Test with passenger nearby for sync.

Test Steps: Set trucker; start job; attach trailer/cargo; deliver; verify payout.
Expected Result: Spawn, route, delivery, payment, and cleanup work.

Test Steps: Set garbage job; start route; collect bags at stops; return truck.
Expected Result: Bag pickup animation and payment work; no duplicate payout.

Test Steps: Set tow; spawn tow truck; tow target vehicle; deliver/impound; verify payout.
Expected Result: Attach/detach works; vehicle state and payout correct.

Test Steps: Set mechanic; access mechanic shop; repair/customize vehicle; charge customer if flow exists.
Expected Result: Only permitted job can use restricted actions; vehicle mods save as expected.

Test Steps: Set vineyard; collect grapes; process into wine/juice; sell/use products.
Expected Result: Pickup, processing, inventory, and payment/item outputs work.

Test Steps: Set police/bcso/sasp; go on duty; target another player; cuff, soft cuff, escort, search, put in/out vehicle.
Expected Result: Only LEO can use actions; target sees correct state; no stuck escort/cuff after relog.

Test Steps: As LEO/admin, jail player for short time; prisoner checks jailtime; complete/unjail; relog mid-sentence.
Expected Result: Jail time persists, inventory handling works, release returns player correctly.

Test Steps: Fire weapon; officer collects casings/blood/fingerprints; use clearcasings/clearblood; inspect inventory evidence.
Expected Result: Evidence appears with metadata and can be cleared/collected only by allowed roles.

Test Steps: Trigger 911/911p, store robbery, shots fired, bank robbery; observe dispatch UI for LEO/EMS.
Expected Result: Correct jobs receive alerts, blips, callsigns, sounds, and expiry.

Test Steps: As police, open MDT; search citizen/vehicle; create report/incident/BOLO; attach mugshot if configured.
Expected Result: Records save and reload; permissions enforced; mugshot/screenshot works.
Notes: SQL qbox import required; screenshot-basic token configured.

Test Steps: Injure/down test player; EMS diagnoses, treats, revives/transports; test hospital respawn.
Expected Result: Injury states, revive, billing/inventory, and hospital locations work.

Test Steps: As medical role, issue prescription; patient redeems/uses medication.
Expected Result: Prescription item/data is correct; access restricted to medical role.

Test Steps: Give phone; use item; open/close NPWD; relog; remove phone and try again.
Expected Result: Phone opens only with phone item; contacts/apps persist.

Test Steps: As admin run testemail; open phone mail; send/receive compatible qb-phone mail event.
Expected Result: Mail notification appears and message is readable.

Test Steps: Own/spawn vehicle; open NPWD garages app; view vehicle list; set waypoint or retrieve if supported.
Expected Result: Owned vehicle data is correct and synced with qbx_garages.

Test Steps: Open phone directory or command; browse listings; set waypoint; show area blips.
Expected Result: Listings display, waypoint/blips set, no NUI errors.

Test Steps: Open bank/ATM; deposit, withdraw, transfer to another player; relog and verify balances.
Expected Result: Balances update once; transfers reach recipient; cash/bank UI consistent.

Test Steps: Run /cash and /bank; add/remove money via admin; observe HUD notifications.
Expected Result: Commands show accurate balances; money change events display correctly.

Test Steps: Visit vehicle shop; preview/test drive; buy with cash/bank/finance; relog; check garage ownership.
Expected Result: Vehicle ownership, plate, keys, garage, and finance records save.

Test Steps: List owned vehicle for sale; second player buys; verify ownership/money transfer.
Expected Result: Seller loses vehicle and receives funds; buyer owns vehicle; no duped keys/vehicle.

Test Steps: At each General shop target/register, open shop; buy water/coffee/soda/srp-eating/clothing_bag/props.
Expected Result: Shop opens at configured target; items purchased with correct metadata and price.
Notes: Target minZ/maxZ values should be checked in-world.

Test Steps: Visit each Liquor location; buy beer/vodka/whiskey; use items.
Expected Result: Shop opens and alcohol consumables work.
Notes: One Liquor target count may be fewer than location count.

Test Steps: Visit Loose Screw and Stiff Board; buy lockpicks/tools/props/skateboard/surfboard; use sample items.
Expected Result: All purchasable items exist and are usable or harmless if decorative.
Notes: Many custom prop items; high coverage priority.

Test Steps: Without weapon license try to buy pistol; with license buy pistol/ammo/armor; inspect metadata serial/registered.
Expected Result: License gating works; weapons receive metadata; ammo/armor purchase correctly.
Notes: Exploit check: no buying restricted weapons without license.

Test Steps: As civilian try to open armoury; as LEO/EMS open; buy grade-restricted items at low/high grade.
Expected Result: Civilian denied; correct jobs/grades can access correct items.
Location/Coords if applicable: MRPD, Del Perro, Vespucci, Paleto, LSMC
Notes: Permission regression risk after job config updates.

Test Steps: Give metalscrap/plastic/steel/aluminium/copper/iron; target Recycling Buyer; sell partial/all amounts; try over 1000.
Expected Result: Buyer pays configured cash prices; amount limit enforced; empty inventory message works.

Test Steps: Find moving fence; sell goldchain/diamond_ring/rolex/stolen items; test police nearby flee behavior.
Expected Result: Fence buys configured items for random price; police proximity causes flee if enabled.
Notes: Requires live multiplayer for police behavior.

Test Steps: Buy/spawn vehicle; lock/unlock; give keys to second player; relog; test no-key start denial.
Expected Result: Keys persist and transfer as intended; no unauthorized driving.

Test Steps: Drive vehicle low on fuel; refuel at pump/can; pay; relog vehicle; verify fuel level.
Expected Result: Fuel changes and persists; payment correct; jerry can works if enabled.
Notes: Vehicle persistence disabled in qbx convar; check expected behavior.

Test Steps: Store owned vehicle; retrieve; damage/fuel state; impound via police/tow; retrieve from depot.
Expected Result: Garage state, damage, fuel, and impound fees work.

Test Steps: Enter civilian and emergency vehicles; test windows/doors/engine/seat/siren controls.
Expected Result: Controls do not conflict; emergency sirens/lights work only where appropriate.

Test Steps: As police in equipped vehicle, enable radar/ANPR; drive past second player vehicle; flag/unflag plate.
Expected Result: Radar displays speed/plate; flagged plate alerts; commands reflect state.

Test Steps: As admin use /doorlock; create/edit test door; lock/unlock; test civilian denial and job access.
Expected Result: Door state syncs for all players; permissions enforced; data persists after restart.
Notes: Data folder appeared empty in quick scan; verify actual DB/file storage.

Test Steps: Start Fleeca/Paleto/Pacific setup with required items; trigger hacks/thermite; observe doors and resets.
Expected Result: Doors open/lock at correct phases; police alerts fire; reset after cooldown/restart.
Notes: Live multiplayer and police count required.

Test Steps: Create or use property; buy/rent; enter/exit; stash; give/remove keys; ring doorbell with second player.
Expected Result: Ownership, keys, stash, doorbell, and interior bucket work.

Test Steps: As admin open property tools; create apartment building; clone/renumber/rename/move entrance/garage; reset bucket.
Expected Result: Only ACE-authorized admins can use tools; changes persist and do not trap players.

Test Steps: Open emote menu; play general/dance/prop/synchronized emotes; cancel; relog.
Expected Result: Animations and props attach/detach cleanly; synced emotes require consent/target.

Test Steps: Use clothing_bag/event bag; place, target, change outfit, pickup by owner and non-owner.
Expected Result: Bag ownership enforced; outfit menu works; no orphaned bag.

Test Steps: Target several chair models; sit; stand using configured commands/keys.
Expected Result: Player sits aligned and can stand without stuck controls.

Test Steps: Use skateboard and surfboard items; ride/place/pickup; test fall/cancel.
Expected Result: Board spawns and controls work; item returns; no vehicle/entity orphan.
Notes: Installed item definitions should be verified in ox_inventory.

Test Steps: Search dumpsters in multiple areas; collect random loot; repeat after cooldown; try spam/cancel.
Expected Result: Loot table works, cooldown/randomness enforced, no infinite-loot exploit.

Test Steps: Go on duty; enter recycling location; pick up packages; drop off; receive materials; exit.
Expected Result: Targets, package entities, rewards, and duty state work.
Notes: Target-heavy; test with multiple players nearby.

Test Steps: Bring eligible vehicle/item; perform scrapyard interaction; receive materials; test cooldown/ownership restrictions.
Expected Result: Rewards correct and exploit checks prevent repeated payout.

Test Steps: As non-admin try open admin menu; as admin open player/vehicle/server/dev pages; perform harmless action.
Expected Result: Permissions enforced; admin actions log or notify as expected.

Test Steps: As admin with bcrp.admintools ACE, use storyspawn/admin commands; as non-admin attempt same.
Expected Result: Only authorized admin can execute; spawned entities clean up.

Test Steps: Run roamingstate and roamingmove for configured actors; observe NPC/vehicle movement and sync for second player.
Expected Result: Commands report/move actor; all clients see same state.

Test Steps: Run fenceprices and questhintlocs; verify output and permissions; compare to in-world NPC.
Expected Result: Commands show expected price/location info without exposing to unauthorized players if restricted.
Notes: Currently RegisterCommand usage should be checked for restrictions.

Test Steps: Perform each section test; after each major flow check F8 for Lua/NUI errors.
Expected Result: No recurring errors, missing exports, missing items, nil values, or NUI callback failures.

Test Steps: Admin watches console during testing; mark errors with timestamp, resource, action being tested.
Expected Result: No server-side stack traces, SQL failures, missing dependency/export errors.
Notes: Especially watch custom bcrp/srp and vendor update resources.

Test Steps: Spam buy/sell/use/cancel; disconnect during progress; repeat with full inventory/zero cash.
Expected Result: No duplicated money/items; failures are clean and reversible.

Test Steps: As wrong job/off duty/low grade, attempt armoury, police actions, boss banking, restricted doors, MDT.
Expected Result: Access denied everywhere expected; no client-side-only permission bypass.

Test Steps: Disconnect while cuffed, jailed, escorted, inside property, in vehicle, during shop purchase, during revive.
Expected Result: Player returns to valid state; no stuck bucket, cuffs, invisible body, duplicated items, or lost money.
